app.title: Label Designer
app.subtitle: Brother VC-500W · designs stay in this browser

tools.dragHint: Drag on canvas; use corners to resize/rotate. Double click text to edit. Delete removes the selection; Ctrl/⌘+C and Ctrl/⌘+V copy and paste.
tools.noSelection: Select an object on the canvas to edit its style, text and position.

cuts.title: Cut markers
cuts.help: Drag a red marker across the canvas or enter its position. The printer cuts across the tape between segments; markers are not printed. Each segment must be at least 10 mm (max. 16 segments).
cuts.markerLabel: Cut marker {{number}} at {{position}} mm; drag to move, Delete to remove
cuts.fullDefault: Cut mode changed to Full because cut markers require a cut.

printer.title: Printer
printer.unavailable: Printer service unavailable; editing remains available.
printer.sent: Sent to printer. If the label is at the output slot, remove it before printing again.
printer.timeout: Timed out waiting for printer confirmation. Check the physical printer before retrying.
printer.removeForNext: Remove segment {{sent}} from the output slot to continue printing {{total}} segments.

confirm.title: Send label to printer?
confirm.description: The print will consume tape. Check the dimensions and cut mode before sending.
confirm.batchNotice: Segments print in order. Remove an output label if the printer waits before the next segment.
confirm.label: Label

errors.invalidImage: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG under 10 MB.
errors.unsafeSvg: SVG contains active or external content.
errors.save: Could not save label (storage may be full).
errors.print: Print failed; check the printer before retrying.
errors.busy: Another print job is already running on this printer.
errors.tapeMismatch: Loaded tape is {{loaded}} mm; design is {{design}} mm.
errors.unknownTape: Cannot confirm a print tape is loaded.
errors.invalidRaster: Image dimensions do not match the label at 313 DPI.
errors.printerFailed: Printer reported an error. Check the printer before retrying.
errors.cutSpacing: Each segment must be at least 10 mm; markers cannot overlap.
errors.cutMode: Cut markers require Full or Half cut.
errors.partial: Batch stopped after sending {{sent}} of {{total}} segments. Check the printed labels before retrying to avoid duplicates.
